mapper.sql: SELECT R.CONTENT_REC_HOUSE_SN, R.REC_CATEGORY_CD, R.HOUSE_SN, R.SORT_ORDER, R.EXPOSE_BGN_DATE, R.EXPOSE_END_DATE, R.EXPOSE_YN, R.REG_DT, H.HOUSE_NM, H.ADDR AS HOUSE_ADDR FROM CONTENT_REC_HOUSE R LEFT JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_REC_HOUSE (REC_CATEGORY_CD, HOUSE_SN, SORT_ORDER, EXPOSE_BGN_DATE, EXPOSE_END_DATE, EXPOSE_YN, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_SN) VALUES (#{recCategoryCd}, #{houseSn}, #{sortOrder}, #{exposeBgnDate}, #{exposeEndDate}, #{exposeYn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn})
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_REC_HOUSE SET REC_CATEGORY_CD = #{recCategoryCd}, HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn}, EXPOSE_BGN_DATE = #{exposeBgnDate}, EXPOSE_END_DATE = #{exposeEndDate}, EXPOSE_YN = #{exposeYn}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE CONTENT_REC_HOUSE_SN = #{contentRecHouseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM HOUSE WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
